title: Facial Recognition & Biometric Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your exposure to facial recognition surveillance and biometric data collection. Get personalized privacy protection recommendations.
description: Assess your vulnerability to facial recognition systems and biometric tracking. This calculator evaluates your digital footprint, location exposure, and privacy practices to determine your biometric privacy risk level.

inputs.label: Photos shared on social media
inputs.helpText: Include profile pictures and tagged photos across all platforms

inputs.label: Time spent in surveilled public spaces
inputs.helpText: Consider airports, retail stores, public transit, and city centers

inputs.label: Location sharing enabled
inputs.helpText: Location services, geotagged posts, or check-ins on apps

inputs.label: Current privacy protection level
inputs.helpText: Include use of privacy tools like Incognito Browser, VPNs, and privacy settings

inputs.label: Devices with biometric authentication
inputs.helpText: Phones, laptops, or other devices using fingerprint, face, or voice recognition

inputs.label: Opted out of data collection services
inputs.helpText: Submitted opt-out requests to Clearview AI, PimEyes, or similar services

outputFields.label: Biometric Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall risk score from 0-100 based on your exposure factors

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Your current risk category with targeted recommendations

outputFields.label: Primary Exposure Factors
outputFields.description: Key areas contributing to your biometric privacy risk

formula: const photoScore = socialMediaPhotos === 'none' ? 0 : socialMediaPhotos === 'minimal' ? 15 : socialMediaPhotos === 'moderate' ? 30 : 45; const publicScore = publicSpaceFrequency === 'minimal' ? 5 : publicSpaceFrequency === 'moderate' ? 15 : publicSpaceFrequency === 'high' ? 25 : 35; const locationScore = locationSharing ? 20 : 0; const deviceScore = Math.min(biometricDevices * 3, 15); const privacyReduction = privacyMeasures === 'none' ? 0 : privacyMeasures === 'basic' ? 5 : privacyMeasures === 'moderate' ? 15 : 25; const optOutReduction = dataOptOuts ? 10 : 0; const riskScore = Math.max(0, photoScore + publicScore + locationScore + deviceScore - privacyReduction - optOutReduction); const riskLevel = riskScore <= 20 ? 'Low Risk' : riskScore <= 40 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore <= 65 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; const factors = []; if (photoScore >= 30) factors.push('High social media photo exposure'); if (publicScore >= 25) factors.push('Frequent surveillance zone presence'); if (locationSharing) factors.push('Active location sharing'); if (deviceScore >= 9) factors.push('Multiple biometric devices'); const exposureFactors = factors.length > 0 ? factors.join(', ') : 'Limited exposure factors identified'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, exposureFactors };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates biometric privacy risk by analyzing your digital photo footprint, physical exposure to surveillance systems, location sharing habits, and current privacy protections. Scores are weighted based on data collection practices of facial recognition companies and surveillance prevalence.
tips: Limit facial photos on social media platforms and review tagged photos regularly
Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser to reduce online tracking
Disable location services and geotagging on photos when possible
Submit opt-out requests to facial recognition companies like Clearview AI
Wear sunglasses or masks in high-surveillance areas when appropriate
Review and tighten privacy settings on all social media accounts
Consider using alternative authentication methods instead of facial recognition
Stay informed about biometric privacy laws in your jurisdiction

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Minimal biometric privacy exposure. Continue current privacy practices and stay vigilant about new threats.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some exposure to biometric tracking. Consider reducing photo sharing and improving privacy settings.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant biometric privacy risk. Take immediate action to limit exposure and enhance privacy protections.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum exposure to facial recognition surveillance. Urgent privacy protection measures needed.
